case_name: Shathya Sheela W/O Late Shivshankar ... vs Superintendent Engineer And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SMT. SHATHYA SHEELA, W/O LATE SHIVSHANKAR INGANKAL
parties.respondent_defendant: BASALINGAPPA 1. SUPERINTENDENT ENGINEER, SHIVARAJ, DHUTTARGAON O AND M GESCOM, etc.

facts_of_case: The petitioner seeks to set aside an order dated 11.03.2020 and quash an endorsement dated 17.03.2017. She also prays for direction to respondents to consider her application seeking compassionate appointment.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise decree or settlement cannot determine eligibility to be appointed on compassionate basis.
legal_principles.held: It is to be held that a compromise decree or settlement arrived at cannot determine the eligibility to be appointed on compassionate basis.

legal_principles.principle: The second marriage while the first spouse is living is held to be void under Section 5(1) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: It was further stated that the legitimacy of the children of the void marriages is only for the purpose of claiming right in the property.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed. The impugned order and endorsement are set aside. Respondents are directed to consider the petitioner's application seeking compassionate appointment.
